facts.text: An unnecessary detection by a warning-only system causes annoyance, distraction and perhaps a voluntary brake application.
facts.quote: With a warning-only system, an unnecessary detection costs annoyance, distraction and perhaps a voluntary brake application.

facts.text: When a system can intervene, a false or nuisance classification becomes a machine-motion command, turning a false positive into both a human-factors and vehicle-dynamics hazard.
facts.quote: Once the system can intervene, a false or nuisance classification becomes a machine-motion command, so the same false positive turns from a human-factors problem into a human-factors and vehicle-dynamics hazard.

facts.text: The ISO 21815 series separates warning from intervention.
facts.quote: The ISO 21815 series recognizes this by separating warning from intervention

facts.text: The ISO 21815 series allows speed reduction, stopping or motion inhibition rather than one universal response.
facts.quote: by allowing speed reduction, stopping or motion inhibition rather than one universal response [80, 81].

facts.text: In the depicted detection-response chain, classification of a nearby object as true and dangerous leads to a protective warning or stop.
facts.quote: C -->|True and dangerous| P[Protective warning or stop]

facts.text: In the depicted detection-response chain, a nuisance classification means a real object presents no danger and leads to an unnecessary alarm or intervention.
facts.quote: C -->|Nuisance: real object, no danger| U[Unnecessary alarm or intervention]

facts.text: In the depicted detection-response chain, a false classification means no object is present and leads to an unnecessary alarm or intervention.
Unnecessary alarms in a warning-only system can lead to annoyance, distraction, ignored alarms and disabling of the audible alarm.
facts.quote: U -->|Warning only| W[Annoyance, distraction, ignored alarms, audible alarm disabled]

facts.text: Unnecessary automatic braking can cause an unplanned stop involving a jolt, load shift, risk from a following vehicle and lost production.
facts.quote: U -->|Automatic braking| M[Unplanned stop: jolt, load shift, following vehicle, lost production]

facts.text: The depicted field-experience chain links the adverse effects of unnecessary warnings and automatic-braking stops to bypass, override, tag removal or zone widening.
facts.quote:
W --> B[Bypass, override, tag removal, zone widening]
    M --> B

facts.text: Bypass, override, tag removal or zone widening can lead to loss of protection when protection is needed.
facts.quote: B --> L[Protection lost when it is needed]
